skill.summary: AI research pipeline with automatic logging. Search via Perplexity, auto-save results to SQLite with topic and project metadata, full Langfuse tracing. Never...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of research-logger.
- Enables automatic logging of research queries and results to SQLite.
- Integrates Perplexity search and saves results with topic and project metadata.
- Provides full Langfuse tracing for every research session.
- Includes CLI for searching, viewing past research, and browsing recent entries.
